description: This file defines an interface 'IOnDeserialized' and an abstract class 'DeserializationContext' within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. The interface declares a method for notification upon deserialization, and the class provides properties related to the deserialization context.

classes.name: DeserializationContext
classes.description: An abstract class providing properties related to the deserialization context, such as ServiceProvider and RuntimeClient.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Method to be implemented by classes to be notified when they are fully deserialized.
